written_before_scores: before KF (253) and KD (254) scores; R, D, K64 scores already seen (252)
method: for each outer fold k: on the other 4 folds' per-cohort-rank OOF, grid the simplex in steps of 0.1 over the families, pick the weight vector maximising pooled AUC (ties -> lower max weight, then lexicographic); apply to fold k ranks. Test weights = the same search on all 5 folds.
report: pooled KS/AUC, per fold, chosen weights per fold, bootstrap vs RDK equal weights and vs REF
note: AUC chosen as selection criterion because it is smoother than KS on 56k rows
